items.title: Farsight and Ornn partner for AI-powered banking
items.snippet: Farsight, the platform helping global financial services firms become AI-native, today announced a partnership with Ornn, which builds financial markets for compute.

items.title: SaverLife launches customised financial wellness app
items.snippet: Today, SaverLife announced the launch of a customized version of its award-winning financial wellness app, designed specifically to support skilled trades workers.

items.title: HSBC launches gen Z education programme
items.snippet: HSBC Private Bank has launched a global educational programme for the heirs of ultra-high net worth (UHNW) clients to help them prepare to be future leaders of their family’s business and wealth.

items.title: ADIB opens digital self-service branch
items.snippet: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB), a leading Islamic financial institution, has opened its new Al Mutarid Branch in Al Ain, introducing a branch concept that brings digital self-service and personalised support together in one location.

items.title: Skybound Wealth appoints former footballer
items.snippet: Skybound Wealth has appointed Jamie Proctor as Head of Athletes & Creators, strengthening the leadership of its specialist division for professional athletes, content creators and their families.

items.title: signtec targets UK financial institutions
items.snippet: signteq, the European identity, trust and compliance platform for regulated industries, is targeting UK financial institutions that serve customers or operate entities in the EU.

items.title: cline/cline SDK v0.0.94
items.snippet: - Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker`) or in the subprocess sandbox (`sandbox`). The `in_process` mode is removed, along with its silent fallback.
